title: Design report
description: One JSON artifact (kind='design_report') per site build, written by the site handler on every path — clean, flagged, skipped, or revised — so an operator can always see which tells the page carries and what the revision loop did (FR-008, FR-014, FR-015). Internal telemetry about the page: never deployed, sent, or published, which is why it carries grounding_status='clean' by construction rather than by scan (research R7). Rule ids and critique kinds are closed sets fixed in code; the only brand-parameterised judgements read the run's own brand doc (FR-009).

lint.description: Deterministic findings on the original page. Empty means clean.

critique.description: The Site Critic's outcome. A schema-valid empty punch list is 'clean' (approval derived from emptiness, mirroring the Reviewer); unusable output or a render/call failure is 'skipped' with the reason — the two are recorded distinctly even though neither triggers a revision by itself (research R5).

revision.description: The fact and outcome of the at-most-one revision pass (FR-014). 'kept' requires: grounding clean, within size budget, lint count not greater than the original's. Both results are recorded — the kept page is the site artifact, the discarded one is this record.

findings_before.description: Lint finding count on the original page.

findings_after.description: Lint finding count on the revised page. Present whenever a revision was produced and linted (kept, discarded_grounding, discarded_worse).

screenshots.description: Whether the headless render ran. captured=false with the critique skipped is the degraded path FR-015 requires the stage to survive.

critique_finding.description: There is deliberately no field for replacement markup or copy: 'never rewrites the page' is a property of this shape (contracts/site-critic.md).
